methodology.observation: Only posts captured in this weekly sampling corpus, not complete account timelines.
methodology.duplicate_definition: Exact match after casefolding, URL removal, mention removal, and whitespace normalization; texts shorter than 20 characters excluded.
methodology.time_window: Publication timestamps of captured posts; no verified 24-hour engagement snapshots.
methodology.interpretation: Exploratory behavioral indicators, not bot identification or a probability of automation.
methodology.limitations: Sampling bias, incomplete account timelines, cross-posting, news syndication, missing account metadata.
